method: Playwright Chromium loaded each route, scrolled every page in 800px steps and all overflowing comparison tables in both axes. Every resulting screenshot was visually inspected using view_image via labelled native-image contact sheets. Scenes were allowed to initialize when visible. Final scene interactions are also covered by root functional tests.
mobileScope: First viewport of all 18 final-supplement routes inspected at 390px, plus the representative revised Plants content screenshot. This is not exhaustive mobile scrolling coverage.
